text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My skin has been breaking out lately...! 
Could it be that I got too carried away 
with my black tea tastings and had too 
much caffeine...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's why we're going strawberry picking! 
Let's get our dose of vitamins!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If my skin turns into any more of a 
wasteland... NOOO, that's scary!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Seeking the Pearl is troubled by 
skin breakouts... For now, let's look up 
places where we can go strawberry picking.
